messages:
secops: Alert — automated leak-detection flagged plaintext credentials inside a diagnostics archive that was queued for external debug sharing. Assume compromise; rotate affected secrets and stop any outbound debug uploads until scrubber is enforced.

nina (build): Which archive? I have the build that created debug-archive-2026-03-25.tar.gz locally.

secops: That one. It contained DATABASE_URL and two long-lived API keys in cleartext. We blocked the outgoing upload and quarantined the file.

omar (infra): Quarantine confirmed. I added tag 'sec-2355554321' and set S3 object to private. Object-level logging enabled.

ryan (oncall): Quick checks for teams: unpack the archive and run a lightweight secret scan:
```
mkdir /tmp/debug; tar -xzf debug-archive-*.tar.gz -C /tmp/debug; rg --hidden "(DATABASE_URL|api_key|secret)" /tmp/debug || true
```

devex-bot: Note: devex/scrub-runner v1.0 currently runs only on manual uploads. Automation patch pending.

nina (build): Root cause: debug builder includes /etc/credentials.d when assembling diagnostics. We shouldn't include system credential dirs. Patch incoming to exclude that path.

secops: Action list:
- Rotate: All credentials found in any quarantined archives immediately.
- Patch: Build team to exclude /etc/credentials.d and add an automated scrub-runner step before any external upload.
- Audit: Scan last 30 days of diagnostics archives for secrets. Report results here within 24h.

omar (infra): Rotations for infra-managed keys started. I'll publish rotated key IDs in SEC-2355554321 ticket.

ryan (oncall): I'll run the archive scan across known buckets and post hits. If you see auth errors after rotation, expect a short remediation window.

nina (build): MR #7129 opened to exclude system dirs and run scrub-runner as a preflight. Canary will run in ~20m.

secops: Enforcement policy update: effective immediately, external debug uploads must pass scrub-runner or be blocked by policy. Doc + automation to follow in 48h. Reply here when rotations and scans are complete.
